result.quote: There he made a covenant with them and put them under oath. He showed them the king’s son
result.reason: The covenant and oath uniquely precede Jehoiada showing the commanders the king’s son, so the key is supported. However, “must” incorrectly suggests an explicit requirement, and “king’s son” needs “the.” A natural version is: “What happened before Jehoiada showed the commanders the king’s son?”
